resources.string: Other languages are read by your phone\'s own offline voice. It sounds plainer than ListenLock\'s English, Hindi and Bengali voices.
Your phone has no offline voice for %1$s yet. Until you add one, ListenLock\'s own voices read this book.
There, tap the gear beside the preferred engine, then Install voice data, and download the language.
This phone has no text-to-speech settings screen to open.
